title: tech-spec
description: A technical specification, its conclusion first: the background, goals and non-goals, the proposed solution with its diagram, decisions with their options and the one taken, what is decided without options, the data and interfaces, what it touches, security and privacy, how it is tested, rolled out and watched, risks, open questions, and sections of your own.

status.description: Where the design stands, such as Draft or Approved, stamped under the title

owner.description: Who wrote it or owns it

summary.description: A sentence or two under the title; a line of Markdown

related.description: Documents it answers to or leads to, such as the requirements it meets

items.description: What it leaves out; a line of Markdown

solution.description: The proposed solution, as a whole

diagram.description: How the pieces fit, under the solution

decisions.description: Each a question and its options; the one taken, marked with pick, heads the page, and one without is undecided

why.description: Why the option taken, or why it is undecided, under it at the top; a line of Markdown

items.description: What is decided without weighing options, such as a rule or a number: a decision's option taken is at the top already; a line of Markdown

data.description: The data's shape, as parts: tables, fields, code

interfaces.description: The APIs and what it exchanges with others, as parts

what.description: What it touches, such as an API, data or operations; a line of Markdown

items.description: What it guards and how, for security and privacy; a line of Markdown
What is tested and how; a line of Markdown

rollout.description: How it goes out, step by step, and how it is undone

items.description: What is watched and when someone is told; a line of Markdown

risk.description: What may go wrong; a line of Markdown

mitigation.description: What is done about it; a line of Markdown

question.description: What is not decided yet; a line of Markdown

more.description: Sections of your own after the rest, each a heading over parts
